evidence: Significantly redesigns src/util/result.h and adds src/util/messages.h to provide typed errors and multi-message support.
rationale: The PR expands util::Result to support typed failure values and merged result states, addressing a key limitation that previously forced functions to rely on ad-hoc tuples and out-parameters. It provides shared error-handling infrastructure that simplifies call sites and directly unblocks downstream refactoring in the kernel and wallet (#25722, #29700).
